entries.424e4011634c0a2b: This business develops and sells DX solutions centered on public document management and approval systems. The company provides the SaaS-based electronic approval and document management system "DocuMaker Office" to local governments and public institutions, and to the administrative departments of medical institutions. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥355 million.

entries.dba4c35cab37684f: This business develops and sells medical devices, and processes and analyzes medical data. It sells the "GAP" visual field meter for medical institutions and "GAP-screener" for health checkup facilities, which analyze eye movements to measure the visual field. It was certified as a "Certified Medical Information Processing Entrusted Business Operator" under the Act on the Promotion of Utilization of Medical Data Including Health Information (Next-Generation Medical Infrastructure Act) on September 30, 2025, and began its medical data platform business on November 1 of the same year. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥63 million.
entries.e8449bd6a324ea80: This business develops, sells and provides consulting for medical systems, and collects and analyzes medical data. The company provides cloud services for image filing system "Claio," document creation system "DocuMaker," medical record writing system "C-Note," electronic medical record "REMORA," endoscopy and ultrasound department system "LIS," radiology report system "ProRad RS," and the "PiCls" series, including a patient guidance app. Its consolidated subsidiary Fitting Cloud Co., Ltd. provides cloud-based products, including the "CocktailAI" medical text generation solution using generative AI. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,691 million.
